The '''DEMP Ion Carbine''' was an electromagnetic pulse weapon manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] While mostly used as a [[Droid Disabler|droid-disabling]] weapon, it could also be used to incapacitate an organic enemy. It was the predecessor to the [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine|DEMP 2 gun]] built on the same principles.

The DEMP gun released a modified-frequency pulse effect that was capable of overwhelming shielding and hardened circuitry and had three adjustable power settings. The normal firing mode was capable of disabling a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for some time, while the weaker setting would only pause it momentarily. At its highest setting, the DEMP gun was capable of inflicting physical damage to a droid's internal components, sometimes causing them to catch on [[Fire/Legends|fire]], and require their complete replacement.

A [[DEMP Ion Pistol|smaller]] version was also available in pistol form.
